note: P3-VOX-07: the phrase the player hears and reads for every voice outcome that is not an accepted action (error taxonomy of p3-15-integration-contracts). Authored text, no clinical value. A subtitle is always present; clip is the pre-rendered audio path once Moiz's P3-SND-08 renders it, null until then (the phrase is then shown as a subtitle and, where available, spoken by the text-to-speech service). Validated by tools/content/validate_ui_guides.py.

outcomes.meaning: The speech was heard but matched no action or question
outcomes.subtitle: Sorry, I did not understand that. Could you say it again?
outcomes.spoken: Sorry, I did not understand that. Could you say it again?
outcomes.practice_extra: Try a shorter sentence, or use the tablet.

outcomes.meaning: More than one action or topic fits what was said
outcomes.subtitle: I am not sure which one you mean. Could you be more specific?
outcomes.spoken: I am not sure which one you mean. Could you be more specific?
outcomes.practice_extra: Say the name of the test, medicine or body part.

outcomes.meaning: The request was addressed to someone who cannot do it, or to nobody in the room
outcomes.subtitle: That is not something this person can help with.
outcomes.spoken: That is not something I can help with. Perhaps someone else could.
outcomes.practice_extra: Face the person you want to talk to, or say who you are asking.

outcomes.meaning: The request is understood but cannot be done at this moment (for example, nobody is there to answer)
outcomes.subtitle: That is not possible right now.
outcomes.spoken: That is not possible right now.
outcomes.practice_extra: Check whether something else needs to happen first.

outcomes.meaning: The simulator refused the action; the reason code is mapped to its player text by HintTexts, the same text the menu shows
outcomes.subtitle: {reason_text}

outcomes.meaning: The speech recogniser returned an error or nothing usable
outcomes.subtitle: I could not hear you clearly. Please try again, or use the tablet.
outcomes.spoken: I could not hear you clearly. Please try again.

outcomes.meaning: The voice service did not answer in time
outcomes.subtitle: That took too long. Please try again, or use the tablet.
outcomes.spoken: That took too long. Please try again.

outcomes.meaning: A significant action is read back and waits for a yes or no (ordering, submitting, hint)
outcomes.subtitle: Please confirm: {action_text}. Say yes to go ahead, or no to cancel.
outcomes.spoken: Please confirm: {action_text}. Say yes to go ahead, or no to cancel.
outcomes.assessment_extra: A hint costs points in the examination.

outcomes.meaning: The voice service cannot be reached; menu mode still works
outcomes.subtitle: Voice is not available right now. You can keep going with the tablet.
outcomes.spoken: Voice is not available right now. You can keep going with the tablet.

outcomes.meaning: The scene or case could not be loaded
outcomes.subtitle: The scenario could not be loaded. Please go back to the menu and try again.
outcomes.spoken: The scenario could not be loaded. Please go back to the menu and try again.

outcomes.meaning: The content failed its integrity check and the session is not started
outcomes.subtitle: The scenario content did not pass its check, so it cannot be used. Please tell the supervisor.
outcomes.spoken: The scenario content did not pass its check, so it cannot be used. Please tell the supervisor.
